footer.nothing_changes: Nothing on the card is changed
footer.nothing_changed: Nothing on the card was changed

settings.title: Settings
settings.save_failed: Your choice could not be saved. It lasts until you close Revenant.

error.lead: Nothing was written to the card. The files you already recovered are still saved.

read_failed.title: Something went wrong while reading the card
read_failed.action: try again. If it keeps happening, make a copy of the card first and look for the files in the copy.

open_failed.title: The card could not be opened
open_failed.action: check that it is still connected and try again. If it keeps happening, take the card out, put it back and wait a few seconds.

permission_denied.title: Revenant did not get permission
permission_denied.action: try again and accept the permission request in the system window.

device_not_found.title: The disk was not found
device_not_found.action: check that it is still connected and choose it again.

system_tool_failed.title: The connected disks could not be listed
system_tool_failed.action: try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, close Revenant and open it again.

unsupported_platform.title: Revenant does not work on this computer
unsupported_platform.action: use Revenant on a Mac or on a Windows PC.

system_disk.title: This is the system disk
system_disk.action: choose the card or the external disk the photos and videos disappeared from. The system disk cannot be searched.

not_whole_disk.title: Choose the whole disk
not_whole_disk.action: go back and choose the card or the disk in the list, not just one part of it.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.action: try again. If it keeps happening, close Revenant and open it again.

disk.system: System disk: it cannot be searched

disks.title: What do you want to recover?
disks.lead: Choose the card or disk the photos and videos disappeared from.
disks.ssd_caution: SSDs and CFexpress cards: deleted files often vanish within minutes. Search as soon as you can.
disks.why_text: On these disks, the system clears the space of deleted files by itself, within a few minutes. The sooner you search, the better the chance of finding everything. Do not use the disk until then.
disks.empty_title: Connect the card or the disk
disks.empty_lead: Put the card in the reader or plug the disk into the USB port. It shows up here by itself, with nothing else to do.
disks.hint_card_rest: Do not save anything on it.
disks.hint_disk_rest: Do not save anything on it.
disks.gone: The disk was not found. Check that it is still connected.

permission.read_only: Revenant only reads. It never writes to the card.
permission.private: Your data never leaves the computer
permission.waiting: Waiting for the system to answer
permission.mac_lead: To read the whole card, not just the visible folders, the Mac needs the administrator password. You type the password in the system window, not here.
permission.mac_step1: Click the button “Ask for the administrator password”.
permission.mac_step2: Type the password you use to log in to the Mac.
permission.mac_step3: Done. The card check starts by itself.
permission.win_title: Windows will ask you to confirm
permission.win_lead: To read the whole card, Windows needs you to allow Revenant as an administrator. It is a normal system question, with Yes and No.
permission.win_step2: Windows asks whether to allow it. Click Yes.
permission.win_step3: Done. The card check starts by itself.
permission.denied_title: Without permission the card cannot be read
permission.denied_lead: The authorization request was cancelled or not accepted. Nothing on the card was changed. Click Try again and confirm as an administrator.

granted.title: Revenant can read {{name}} ({{size}}).
granted.lead: The search comes in the next version.
